result.keywords: This paper examines modular berthing protocols for autonomous supply depots operating in tidal estuary environments, emphasizing corrosion-aware scheduling, packetized inventory handoff, and adaptive mooring geometry. A hybrid simulation framework is proposed to compare fixed-pier and floating-dock configurations under varying surge conditions, with results indicating improved throughput for low-drift cargo capsules and reduced alignment error during night operations. The study concludes with design recommendations for resilient inland harbor automation and low-noise maintenance workflows.
result.title: Velvet Anchorage in Lunar Logistics.
